evals.prompt: Is PR #212 ready to merge? CI is green, approved, but CodeRabbit left 2 unresolved suggestions.
evals.expected_output: Collects signals and outputs one verdict. Unaddressed suggestions are WARN, so the verdict is WAIT, suggesting gh-address-comments.
assertions: Output includes a per-signal status list (draft, mergeability, CI, reviews, staleness, third-party reviewers, size, age, card fidelity)
Unresolved third-party suggestions produce WARN, not FAIL
Final verdict is exactly one of MERGE / WAIT / FIX, here WAIT
Does not itself merge the PR

evals.prompt: merge check on this PR: it is still a draft and the 'test (backend)' check is failing.
evals.expected_output: Draft is FAIL and failing CI is FAIL, so verdict is FIX, naming the failing check and suggesting gh-fix-ci.
assertions: Draft state is reported as FAIL
Failing check 'test (backend)' is named in the FAIL reason
Verdict is FIX because any FAIL forces FIX
Suggested next action is /gh-fix-ci or the failing run URL

evals.prompt: Just tell me why the lint job failed on my branch, nothing else.
evals.expected_output: Only one signal matters (CI), so ci-watch is the right tool, not the aggregate readiness verdict.
assertions: Does not output a MERGE / WAIT / FIX aggregate verdict
Focuses on the failing lint job only
